title: Starvie Junior 2025 - Star Vie
description:
STARVIE JUNIOR 2025 - Starvie's junior racket, for children who are starting out in this sport. INTRODUCTION OF THE SHOVEL

Are you looking for a junior racket? The STARVIE JUNIOR 2025 is one of the alternatives we have for the little ones. Quality alternative, very comfortable and light weight.

PLAYER TYPE

Recommended for a child who is starting to play.

CHARACTERISTICS OF THE PADDLE

The STARVIE JUNIOR 2025 has the following characteristics:

- Round shape. It ensures low balance and good mobility.

- Low weight. Its weight is around 330 grams.

- Made of fiberglass.

- Xtreme Spot technology that increases the sweet spot.

PLAY STYLE

It is a wing with a lot of control, ideal for learning correctly in the first steps in this wonderful sport.
